codes.title: Chest pain, unspecified
evidence_quotes: chest pain since yesterday after unloading maize sacks.
pain fully reproducible on palpation of costochondral area
codes.reasoning: The patient presented with musculoskeletal chest pain that was fully reproducible on costochondral palpation following physical activity. Per GDL-001, acute myocardial infarction (BA41) is excluded due to the reproducible musculoskeletal character and absence of ischemic features.
